items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: So between Harry Dial and Lem Johnson they'll alternate (unintelligible) doing Roane these funerals, because and I, we were stuck with the warden's part, so we just did the part that's -- every time they had a (unintelligible) the funeral, 11 of them that year.

ctx.x: Well, the only thing I don't understand, if you're a musician traveling, you know, or in a big band or anything, how do you keep up with the --
Well, a lot of times -- like, for instance, I quit the road, and Lem, he quit the road. Dial, he been working around -- all of us working on --
But I mean a guy like Jonah and Cozy (unintelligible), I mean they're out of town a lot.
